rationale: Steven is building brain-inspired memory systems for personal AI agents with a focus on private, local-first architecture, while Shiza is designing hardware and mechanical systems at the frontier of humanoid robotics — both are hands-on founders who believe in building meaningful products at the intersection of AI and physical systems rather than chasing hype. Steven's deep TypeScript/Rust engineering background and conviction that 'building towards artificial consciousness is a tractable engineering goal' could complement Shiza's computer vision, C++, and experience shipping real hardware subsystems at 1X, where frontier AI meets embodied systems.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Shiza Charania — you're both hands-on founders shipping at the AI frontier (personal agents with brain-inspired memory vs. humanoid robotics), and your complementary stacks (his TypeScript/Rust + her computer vision/C++) could unlock something interesting around embodied AI systems.
